लंदन की कड़कड़ाती ठंड और सुबह 5 बजे का जिम, Arjun Rampal अपनी नई OTT सीरीज के लिए पूरी तरह तैयार हैं! 🎬

Hansal Mehta और Robbie Grewal के डायरेक्शन में बन रही सीरीज Billionaire की शूटिंग London में शुरू हो चुकी है।

16 November 2026 को Arjun Rampal ने चलती कार से एक वीडियो शेयर कर अपने Day 1 की अपडेट दी, जहाँ उन्होंने बताया कि वो सुबह 5 बजे उठकर वर्कआउट करके सेट के लिए निकले।

रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक इस शो में Jennifer Winget, Sapna Pabbi और Vipin Sharma भी अर्जुन के साथ नजर आएंगे।

Prabhleen Sandhu द्वारा प्रोड्यूस यह सीरीज एक महत्वाकांक्षी बिजनेस टायकून के साम्राज्य की कहानी है, जो Amazon MX Player पर स्ट्रीम होगी। 🎥

ctx.text:
Arjun Rampal begins shooting for Hansal Mehta and Robbie Grewal's Billionaire in London, sharing a video from his first day on set.
Actor Arjun Rampal has begun filming for Billionaire, an upcoming original series directed by Hansal Mehta and Robbie Grewal. The actor shared the update on November 16, 2026, in a social media video that offered a glimpse of his first day of shooting in London.
In the video, Arjun is seen travelling inside a moving car as he greets his followers and talks about starting work on the series. Sharing his excitement about the project, he said, “Hey guys, good morning. Greetings from London. First day of shoot today, day one of Billionaire. Very, very special show and something I'm really, really excited about.”
The actor also spoke about his early-morning routine before heading to the set. “Woke up at 5am, went to the gym and now heading to shoot. We're in cold London. So, wish me luck and have a great day,” he said, before signing off with a greeting for his followers across different time zones.
Arjun was announced as the lead of Billionaire in March 2026 at Amazon's Connected Worlds event in Mumbai. The series is being produced by Prabhleen Sandhu under the banner Almighty Motion Picture. Anubhav Chopra and Shantanu Sagara have written the project.
Set against the backdrop of a rapidly changing India, Billionaire follows the rise of a powerful business magnate who builds an empire through ambition and influence. The narrative will explore how his growing success affects his personal and professional relationships.
As previously reported by Bollywood Hungama , Jennifer Winget, Sapna Pabbi and Vipin Sharma have also joined the cast. The series was scheduled to begin filming on November 15 in and around London, with the production planned across real locations and specially constructed sets.
Billionaire will stream on Amazon MX Player. The makers have yet to announce its release date.
